dogecoin.text:
Ever think the goal is to make #crypto look like a joke? $DOGE, $SHIB, and now $APE? No hate by any means and I understand the land sale, but you know the articles will all be "APE surges while market falls".

Every article like that is slowing adoption dramatically IMO

I missed $DOGE from over-analyzing the fundamentals I missed $SHIB from underestimating the power of retail. I'm not missing $LUNA / $UST with the possibility of the largest financial comeback of all time. A comeback will be a BIG net positive for #crypto

#lunatothemoon  #sendit

1. Retail Apes. We've seen what retail can do with $DOGE and $SHIB. How many saw tweets/posts  about people being up multiple X's? How many people saw "if I lose it, I lose it"? Yep. Sounds like the other ones.
